ms.report:
On-Chain Delegation implementation
We have successfully implemented and deployed the delegation mechanism on the Cardano preprod testnet. Our smart contracts allow users to delegate their voting power in a secure and fully transparent on-chain way.
To delegate, users must lock (stake) their governance tokens in the smart contract and select a delegatee (the person who will receive the voting power) and a time period. While the tokens are locked, the delegatee receives delegation tokens, which allow them to vote using the delegated voting power.
Each delegation has a fixed end time chosen by the user. After this time period ends, the user can unlock their tokens and regain full control of their voting power. If the user wants to unlock earlier, they must first recover the delegation tokens from the delegatee. This ensures that voting power cannot be used and withdrawn at the same time.
Users can also update or revoke their delegation. All delegation actions are recorded and verifiable on-chain.

Open Delegated Staking Position: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/559dd3047951ab70663dd2e54e59422d35860abdc2fc8e59da78b9ee989243b9
